rows.en: Touya: "How is Lodis doing?"
Ymir: "His injuries weren't as serious as we thought.
His internal organs weren't damaged, either.
His Majesty the King is safe, too.
The terrorist attack in the capital has been put down,
so we can breathe a little easier for now.
But Marshal Revios died protecting His Majesty..."
Touya: "I see... Maybe he was loyal to the end after all."
Ymir: "Yes. His love for his country was genuine..."
Touya: "Even if things have settled down for now,
those terrorists are still alive... We can't relax yet."
Ymir: "Yes. But this must have dealt them
considerable losses.
They won't be able to act as an organization for a while."
Yamato: "Hmm...
Huh? Come to think of it, Sisk isn't here...
Is she with His Highness Lodis after all?"
Ymir: "Y-Yes. She seems to be enthusiastically
doing all sorts of things to look after him."
Miyasco: "She just told me I was in the way
and chased me out."
Touya: "What about Celica?"
Ymir: "She's in her room.
But let her be for now."
Celica: "I'm all right. I'm not a child, either.
Besides, until we help Tix,
I can't afford to sit around feeling down."
Touya: "Are you all right?"
Celica: "Yes... Sorry I worried you."
Ymir: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, haven't we been flying over the capital
for a while now, meow...? What are we doing?"
Miyasco: "What? Oh, we're helping put out the fires.
Since the head of Parliament was a terrorist, there seems to be all sorts of confusion,
and the administration isn't functioning properly."
Maki: "Hi there!"
Touya: "Fain's not here."
Maki: "Huh? I don't need Fain-chan for anything.
Besides, I've already said goodbye to him."
Ymir: "Goodbye?"
Maki: "Yes. I'm leaving Liebhofen here."
Touya: "That's sudden."
Maki: "Is it? Well, your fight against ≪Ze=Ode≫...
Now I know you're serious. And I know there are other things
whose truth I should expose.
More than anything, I feel that if I stay with you any longer,
I'll lose my ability to view things calmly as a journalist."
Touya: "You say that, but you mean to report on the situation in this capital,
don't you?"
Maki: "Oh, you saw through me? But that's not all.
If I stay here, Reisuke might end up with a drill attached.
Right, Princess?"
Celica: "What?! H-Ha ha ha... I would never...
even think of anything like that!
H-Ho ho ho ho..."
Touya: "...You were thinking about it..."
Maki: "Well, that's how it is. See you."
Yamato: "...Hey, Touya. Don't you feel like we're forgetting something, meow?"
Touya: "Hm? What do you mean?"
Rosalie: "Oh! So this is where you've been hiding!
Hey! What are you going to do about our shop?!"
Touya: "...Oh, right. I stepped on it and crushed it..."
Rosalie: "That shop! That shop was something I worked so hard to...
Gen: "Whoa?! S-Sis?!
Hang in there, Sis!"
Touya: "H-Hey, are you all right?"
Rosalie: "Hey..."
Touya: "Wh-What?"
Rosalie: "Pay for it."
Touya: "What?! P-Pay for it...?"
Ymir: "Touya doesn't have any money.
If you want compensation, the Holy Land could..."
Rosalie: "No! ...It was Touya piloting Rayblade.
He was the one in it, so Touya takes responsibility and pays!
That's how it ought to be, isn't it?"
Touya: "Come on... Don't ask the impossible...!"
Rosalie: "Ugh... H-How cruel...
That shop held so many memories of our dead parents...
So many... And you..."
Gen: "S-Siiis..."
Touya: "H-Hey... Honestly... What am I supposed to do?"
Touya: "Aaagh... Damn it, all right!
I'll cover the cost of the shop! And until your new home's ready,
I'll get things arranged so you can work here!
Will that do?!"
Rosalie: "...And with that, we have a deal.
Well, you can't pay it all at once, so I'll allow two hundred and forty
installments.
Now, the going rate is about this much...
and the fee would be this much..."
Ymir: "Two hundred and forty installments...? The fees will be enormous..."
Rosalie: "Heh heh heh..."
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...It seems we misunderstood.
Good luck paying off your debt."
Rosalie: "Thank you for your business!"
Touya: "...*sigh*"
Ymir: "Captain, are you really sure?"
Roa: "Yes."
Ymir: "Understood. Rosalie, starting today,
you'll be looking after everyone's meals in the galley.
All right?"
Rosalie: "Of course! I'm a professional, too, after all.
Don't worry. I won't serve anything half-baked."
Kasumi: "Then we're companions from today on. Nice to have you with us."
Rosalie: "Likewise. ...Hey, Gen. You, too...
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:F0> Huh? Where on earth has he gone...?"
Gen: "Wooow... Spirit Mechs really are cool...
Whoa! Rayblade! Awesome!!"
Mechanic C: "Hey! It's dangerous to stand there!"
Gen: "Wow... It's huuuge..."
Mechanic C: "Honestly... Hey!"
Mechanic F: "Oh, let him be.
Hey, kid. Do you like Spirit Mechs?"
Gen: "Yes! When I grow up, I'm definitely going to be
a Spirit Mech Pilot! And then a knight!"
Mechanic E: "Oh... You've got quite a look in your eyes.
Maybe it won't just end up being a dream."
Mechanic B: "Oh, if that's your judgment, it must be right.
Hey, kid. When you're a knight, we'll maintain your machine for you."
Gen: "Really?! Hooray! That's a promise!"
Mechanic B: "Yeah. A promise."
Gen: "All riiight... Oh... What's that...?"
Mechanic A: "That's the Spirit Mech Zeifon.
Touya was piloting it until a little while ago.
It's vacant now.
It's a fine machine, but there's no pilot.
Even though we keep it ready to use at any time..."
Gen: "Hmm... So it can fight any time."
Mechanic D: "Of course. Our maintenance is always perfect."
Gen: "Um, then..."
Rosalie: "Gen! Honestly, it's dangerous to go wandering off
on your own! Come on, we're going!"
Gen: "Aww, aww! Just a little longer!"
Rosalie: "No! We need to start preparing tonight's dinner
right away! Come along, now!"
Gen: "W-Well, good luck with your work!"
Mechanic B: "Yeah! Come visit again, kid!"
Touya: "...Is it true Lodis was wounded?!"
Ymir: "Yes. With Prince Tix in danger from Cain,
he was trying to protect him..."
Touya: "Cain? What's he plotting this time?!"
Ymir: "I don't know. But it seems he was trying to take Prince Tix
away with him."
Yamato: "So how is His Highness doing, meow?"
Ymir: "His injuries weren't as serious as we thought.
His internal organs weren't damaged, either.
His Majesty the King is safe, too.
The terrorist attack in the capital has been put down,
so we can breathe a little easier for now.
But Marshal Revios died protecting His Majesty..."
Touya: "I see... Maybe he was loyal to the end after all."
Ymir: "Yes. His love for his country was genuine..."
Touya: "Even if things have settled down for now,
those terrorists are still alive... We can't relax yet."
Ymir: "Yes. But this must have dealt them
considerable losses.
They won't be able to act as an organization for a while."
Touya: "I hope this is the end of it..."
Maki: "Hi there!"
Touya: "Fain's not here."
Maki: "Huh? I don't need Fain-chan for anything.
Besides, I've already said goodbye to him."
Ymir: "Goodbye?"
Maki: "Yes. I'm leaving Liebhofen here."
Touya: "That's sudden."
Maki: "Is it? Well, your fight against ≪Ze=Ode≫...
Now I know you're serious. And I know there are other things
whose truth I should expose.
More than anything, I feel that if I stay with you any longer,
I'll lose my ability to view things calmly as a journalist."
Touya: "You say that, but you mean to report on the situation in this capital,
don't you?"
Maki: "Oh, you saw through me? Well, that's how it is. See you."
Ai: "I've finally caught you."
Kururu: "Oh, come on! Let go! Let go of me!"
Kasumi: "Kururu, don't give us big girls
so much trouble."
Ymir: "Even if we let you off for sneaking aboard,
going out in a Spirit Mech...
Things worked out this time, but if they'd gone badly,
you could have died, you know?"
Kururu: "That's not true!
I can fight just fine, too!"
Touya: "..."
Ai: "Look... Getting Forstin moving right away
was certainly amazing, and you may have talent.
But this isn't a game, you know?"
Kururu: "I know that.
I'm going to be a great knight like my dad!
That's why I'll fight, too!"
Kasumi: "Kururu! You were aboard?!"
Kururu: "But..."
Ymir: "No buts. Your mother and father
must be worried about you."
Kururu: "I want to fight alongside you, too.
Mom and Dad will understand!"
Clovis: "Look... Fighting isn't the same as playing, you know?"
Kururu: "I know that!
I can fight just fine, too!"
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...Being able to move Griol
is certainly impressive, and you may have talent.
But real battle is different, you know?"
Kururu: "I know that.
I'm going to be a great knight like my dad!
That's why I'll fight, too!"
Ai: "Hey, Touya. You say something, too."
Touya: "Kururu. Do you really want to fight?
This isn't a simulator. You could die.
If you get into trouble, no one's going to save you."
Kururu: "Don't treat me like a child! I can fight, too!
And I'm not scared of dying!"
Touya: "!!"
Kururu: "...What?"
Ymir: "Touya..."
Touya: "Don't say something like that so lightly!
You're not scared of dying?!
Do you only ever think about yourself?!"
Kururu: "Wh-What...? What...?"
Touya: "If you died, how would Thora and Grad feel?
Do you think they'd be happy? It might be fine for you.
You'd get to die playing the hero.
But have you ever thought about how much grief
you'd cause the people left behind?"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Kururu: "Ugh..."
Touya: "If you really want to fight,
I don't mind, and I'll ask the captain for you.
But if you mean to play the hero without thinking about
the parents who love you, I won't allow it.
I'll keep you off the battlefield even if I have to tie you up.
........Listen, Kururu. Thora asked me
to look after you.
So don't say you're not scared of dying... Please."
Kururu: "Ugh... I'm sorry... I'm sorry..."
Touya: "I'm sorry I hit you, too. Are you all right?"
Kururu: "...Yes, I'm all right..."
Touya: "Sorry for lecturing you.
But fighting isn't just about you.
Please understand that much."
Kururu: "...Okay."
Touya: "All right. Then think it over once more,
and tell me afterward, would you?"
Kururu: "Okay... I understand. I'll think properly."
Touya: "All right. Good girl."
Kururu: "Booo! Don't treat me like a child!"
Touya: "Ha ha ha, sorry."
Aurelie: "Touya. You've gone up a little in my estimation.
...Come on, Kururu. Let's go."
Kururu: "Oh... H-Hey..."
Touya: "Hm? What's wrong?"
Kururu: "I've... never been hit before..."
Touya: "What? Oh, right..."
Kururu: "You were a little scary earlier, Touya,
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03><FC:02:3E><FC:84:3C:16:02><FC:01:3E><FC:84:3C:16:F0> but you were kind of cool."
Touya: "W-Was I?"
Kururu: "Yes. If it's you, Touya...
<FC:3C:3E><FC:84:3C:16:03><FC:01:3E><FC:84:3C:16:05> I might let you be my husband when I grow up."
Ymir: "H-Husband?!"
Touya: "H-Ha ha ha... You've got me there... Ow!"
Ai: "What are you grinning about?!
Hmph... Good for you.
You've got such a cute fiancee!"
Kasumi: "..."
Kururu: "Hmm. I see... Looks like there's a lot of competition.
But I won't lose, either."
Yamato: "Oh, what a mess!"
Celica: "...Are you all right?"
Lodis: "You worry too much.
I'm fine. Look, just like... Ow, ow, ow!"
Celica: "Oh! Don't push yourself! Honestly, Brother..."
Lodis: "...It seems Cain is after my life..."
Celica: "What?!"
Lodis: "Rather than kill me right away, he seems to want
to make me suffer some other way, and kill me in the end."
Celica: "...Could it be about our brother Rayfon?"
Lodis: "Yes. He looked up to Rayfon
like a real brother..."
Celica: "B-But..."
Lodis: "I hurt Rayfon...
To him, that alone was enough.
I wasn't myself back then..."
Celica: "Brother..."
Dei: "...Ioannis... You've disappointed me.
I never thought you'd go this far..."
Ioannis: "Wh-What?! It failed in the end, didn't it?!
Revios was killed instead of Lodis..."
Ioannis: "Ghh... You... hit me... Me..."
Dei: "Inviting a man like you in seems to have been
the greatest mistake of my life. Get out! And never again
show your face before us!"
Ioannis: "...Y-You're impressive.
But... Don't think everything will go
exactly as you intend... Heh heh heh."
Doris: "Stop it! You're ignoring your own failure..."
Ioannis: "S-Shut up! You, too...
Why do you like a man like this?!
I've got more status and money!"
Doris: "...What do you intend to do with that gun?
You don't even have the nerve to pull the trigger."
Ioannis: "...I-I'm serious... This isn't a threat!"
Dei: "Ioannis, put that dangerous thing away..."
Ioannis: "D-Don't give me orders!!"
Dei: "Gah!"
Doris: "Dei!!"
Ioannis: "Heh... Heh heh heh..."
Goh: "What was that gunshot?!"
Render: "R-Rakbal... Rakbal!"
Resh: "Ioannis... You bastard..."
Ioannis: "I-It's his fault...
Because he treated me as a nuisance... Me... Heh heh heh..."
Ioannis: "?!"
Doris: "Dei!"
Doris: (...B-But it definitely hit him...
To be unharmed at that distance... No, Dei is alive...
That's all that matters.)
Dei: "Heh heh heh...
Should I thank you, Ioannis?"
Doris: "What...? D-Dei...?"
Ioannis: "Y-Your f-face..."
?????: "My face? Oh, this is my original face.
My somatic cells have simply begun to reconstruct."
Resh: "Rakbal...?"
Ioannis: "W-Who are you?"
?????: "Shall I introduce myself?
I thought there was no need."
Ioannis: "?! That face... You couldn't be...
You... No, you are..."
?????: "Yes. The leader you all wished for..."
Ioannis: "B-Bafred Debish!"
Debish: "Yes. Correct."
Ioannis: "Gah! W-Why? You... *cough*"
Debish: "I'm not so virtuous that I would employ
incompetent people. And you were incompetent.
That's all there is to it."
Render: "..."
Debish: "...Now, then."
Kinari: "E-Eek!"
Debish: "There's no need to be so frightened.
All I ask of you is one thing. Absolute loyalty.
Simple, isn't it?"
Render: "My life is yours, Debish..."
Doris: "..."
Debish: "Doris... Won't you come with me?"
Doris: "Where is he...? Where is Dei?"
Debish: "He died... No, that's not right.
He became one with me. He is me, and I am also him.
Though this is the result of his research...
because he accepted me."
Doris: "..."
Debish: "Didn't you fall in love with Dei himself?
With his existence, rather than his appearance,
and his soul?
Look into my eyes. Is anything different?
The Dei you fell for is me."
Doris: "...You're..."
Debish: "Yes. Come with me, Doris."
Doris: "...Yes."
Debish: "Very good. Then let us begin
the banquet of revival..."
Touya: "!! Wh-What's this horrible feeling...?"
Roa: "Hm?!"
Miyasco: "Th-That..."
Ymir: "Wh-What is... that...? It couldn't be..."
Yamato: "Th-That's..."
Leone: "What? What is it? What's going on?
So that really is... This is a problem..."
Ymir: "≪Ze=Ode≫... Goderius..."
